subject: [PATCH v2 08/11] nfsd: apply delegated times in a separate times-only setattr

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch separates the application of delegated times from other attributes in an NFS server. It introduces a new function to apply vetted times, which skips export checks and lease handling. The patch also updates attribute reporting and error handling for delegated times. Additionally, it removes support for delegated times in CREATE and OPEN operations and adds support for minor versions without delegated times.
